reaction_time_definition: Decision + reaction time measured in hindsight, not a pure reflex: median delay from a Metrica pass (>= 10 m, >= 0.8 s flight) being struck until the defender nearest its target accelerates towards the target at > 1.5 m/s^2, over the passes in games 1-2 where that defender was not already accelerating towards it. The shared field name is reaction_time_s.
